'''Adi Gallia's flagship'''<ref name="BR2D2">{{BuildR2Cite|14|Droid Directory}}</ref> was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] commanded by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was destroyed in a [[Battle of Patitite Pattuna/Legends|battle]] near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Patitite Pattuna/Legends|Patitite Pattuna]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] forces, and Gallia was subsequently taken [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] General.<ref name="Nomad Droids" />
